attchmntText: Radiant Cash Management Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Radiant Cash Management Services Limited filed an investor presentation for its earnings conference call scheduled on November 13, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. The presentation covers un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, standalone total income was Rs. 1101 million, EBITDA was Rs. 84 million, and PAT was Rs. 39 million. Consolidated revenue stood at Rs. 1095 million, with consolidated EBITDA at Rs. 76 million and PAT at Rs. 21 million. The company reported a revenue growth of 7.5% year-on-year. Operational highlights include coverage of 15,165 pin codes, 79,374 touch points, and total cash movement of Rs. 410 billion. The company added 113 new end customers during the quarter.

attchmntText: Radiant Cash Management Services Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Radiant Cash Management Services Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 12, 2026. The statutory auditors issued an unmodified review report. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 1,077.36 million INR. Profit after tax was 38.52 million INR. Earnings per share was 0.36 INR. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 2,128.13 million INR. Profit after tax was 118.93 million INR. Earnings per share was 1.11 INR. Total assets as at September 30, 2026, stood at 4,684.99 million INR. Net cash used in operating activities for the period was 8.18 million INR.

attchmntText: Radiant Cash Management Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Radiant Cash Management Services Limited has scheduled an earnings conference call for the un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The event is scheduled for Friday, November 13, 2026, at 11:00 AM IST. The senior management team will include Col. David Devasahayam, CMD, Mr. Alexander David, Whole time Director, Mr. T. V. Venkataramanan, CFO, Col. Benz Jacob, COO, and Mr. N. Muthuraman, Director. The call is organized by Antique Stock Broking Limited. Participants can dial in using Universal Access numbers +91 22 6280 1342 or +91 22 7115 8243. International toll-free numbers are available for various countries including the USA, UK, and Australia. For enquiries, contact Mr. Raju Barnawal at Antique Stock Broking Limited.
